## Requirements: WebSocket Runtime V2 — classified outbound and connection settlement

### Scope and independent delivery
Parent #4431; main baseline e656d1f9c95baafc8735a2bb0274f668a2cc30d7. No historical Issue is reopened, reused or required for execution. Own nession-runtime outbound writer, queue scheduler and connection settlement primitives, plus write-side adapters of Server, Agent P2P, Agent central and Relay; CommandBroker pending lifetime cleanup. No hard dependency on ingress or stream work: consume existing producers with explicit class adapters. Historical #3547/#3548/#4065/#960 are regression constraints, not work packages.
Baseline: Server/P2P share one queue across different semantic sends (8/4 MiB nominal, 64 frames); Agent central response channel has 32 slots only; sink.send awaited inside select arm can stall Ping/shutdown. Inspect actual oversized-frame accounting, broker timeout/revoke/generation, writer exits and forced reader abort paths.
Design:
- One Writer per physical socket; explicit Control/Response/Stream queues with reserved class capacity, per-connection and process aggregate byte/count accounting including in-flight frame and producer-held reservations; no clamped accounting that treats a large allocation as smaller than it is. Define supported maximum/chunking via owning wire contract; retain Agent state outbox coalescence/ordering.
- Bounded fair priority scheduler (bounded control burst, response protection, byte-aware stream scheduling); no promise of preempting a write already in flight. Finite write/flush/close deadlines; unhealthy socket closes, reason propagates to read side independently of reader activity.
- Connection lifecycle supervisor settles both halves, tasks and registrations exactly once on EOF/error/close/stall/shutdown, generation-fenced; abort/cancel safe even while admission is parked. Request pending map terminal outcomes include response, timeout, cancellation, delivery failure, replacement and disconnect; stale generations and late/duplicate response cannot settle a different request. No side effect auto-retry. Preserve existing relay half-open and detach behavior.
- Public seam: submit classified frame with generation/ownership and explicit accepted/refused/closed, finite wait only where caller contract permits; writer consumes fair scheduler; lifecycle cancellation event consumable by ingress. Emit queue/wait/write/close/pending metrics at owner, no exporter dependency. Keep domain-specific stream replay/authority in D.

### Success Criteria
- [x] SC-01 Deterministic queue/sink tests at PR head prove exact count/byte budgets including in-flight/oversized frames, control reservation, response non-silent failure, bounded fairness and preserved Agent outbox latest-state behavior with continuously backlogged streams.
- [x] SC-02 A source-aligned staging protocol/runtime Case with a stalled sink/peer proves finite write deadline and propagation to reader, no half-open task or registry leak, and slow peer does not stop another connection; exercise Server, P2P, central and Relay leg.
- [x] SC-03 Exact-head broker/lifecycle fault tests prove pending entries settle once for response/timeout/cancellation/revoke/replacement, old generations and late replies cannot affect the new owner, and cleanup completes for normal/error/forced exit.

SC → scenario: SC-01 SCN-06 (exact PR-head focused CI/Gate/test or document evidence; read-only Agent reviews authenticated result); SC-02 SCN-03 (isolated source-aligned staging Case; trusted run/attempt/SHA evidence); SC-03 SCN-01 (exact PR-head focused CI/Gate/test or document evidence; read-only Agent reviews authenticated result). For runtime Cases use approved full-stack-local protocol/runtime verifier with private tmux and bounded fault injection; for Knowledge publication use existing trusted publisher/readback receipt, never grant PR credentials. No blanket Full E2E or production probe.
